decision: Stop and go penalty imposed after the Race. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly), team representative and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry and in-car video evidence. The driver and team representative claimed that the driver had made a significant reduction in speed in the double yellow flag sector however a detailed examination of the telemetry and that of other cars passing through that sector, led the Stewards to conclude that the small reduction noted was not sufficient to satisfy the requirements of the regulations.
fact: The driver passed through a double yellow flag sector and did not make the required reduction in speed.
offence: Breach of Article B1.8.4b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
